What is Procedure Text?

A procedure text guides readers through a sequence of actions to achieve a goal.

Definition

A procedure text is a text that explains how to do or make something through a sequence of clear and ordered steps.

Communicative Purpose

  • To explain how something is made.
  • To explain how something is done.
  • To give clear instructions.
  • To guide readers to complete a task.

Pengertian

Procedure text adalah teks yang menjelaskan cara melakukan atau membuat sesuatu melalui serangkaian langkah yang jelas dan berurutan.

Tujuan Komunikatif

  • Menjelaskan cara membuat sesuatu.
  • Menjelaskan cara melakukan sesuatu.
  • Memberikan petunjuk yang jelas.
  • Memandu pembaca menyelesaikan suatu tugas.

Structure & Language Features

Identify the organization and language commonly used in procedure texts.

Generic Structure

GOAL / AIM→MATERIALS / EQUIPMENT→STEPS / METHODS→RESULT

1. Goal / Aim

The purpose or final result of the procedure.

Tujuan atau hasil akhir yang ingin dicapai.

2. Materials / Ingredients / Equipment

Things needed to complete the procedure.

Bahan, benda, atau alat yang diperlukan.

3. Steps / Methods

A sequence of instructions explaining what to do.

Tahapan yang dilakukan secara berurutan.

Language Features

Imperatives: Cut the vegetables. Add two tablespoons of sugar.

Simple Present: The machine heats the water.

Connectors: First, next, then, after that, finally.

Adverbs: carefully, slowly, for five minutes.

Procedure Text: Recipes

A recipe tells us how to prepare food or a drink step by step.

How to Make a Fruit Smoothie

Ingredients

  • 1 banana
  • 1 cup of milk
  • ½ cup of strawberries
  • 1 tablespoon of honey
  • Ice cubes

Equipment

  • Blender
  • Glass
  • Spoon
  • Knife

Steps

1First, peel and slice the banana.
Pertama, kupas dan iris pisang.
2Next, wash the strawberries.
Selanjutnya, cuci stroberi.
3Put the banana and strawberries into the blender.
Masukkan pisang dan stroberi ke dalam blender.
4Add the milk and honey.
Tambahkan susu dan madu.
5Add some ice cubes and blend until smooth.
Tambahkan es batu dan blender hingga halus.
6Finally, pour the smoothie into a glass and serve.
Terakhir, tuangkan smoothie ke gelas dan sajikan.

Procedure Text: Manuals

A manual provides instructions for using or operating a device.

How to Use a Digital Air Fryer

Equipment

  • Digital air fryer
  • Food to cook
  • Heat-resistant container if needed

Steps

1Place the air fryer on a stable surface.
2Plug the power cord into an electrical outlet.
3Put the food into the basket.
4Close the basket properly.
5Select the desired temperature and cooking time.
6Press the start button and wait until cooking is complete.
7Carefully remove the food.
▣

Safety Instructions

  • Read the instructions carefully.

  • Unplug the appliance after use.
